evals.prompt: Add an endpoint group to osapi that reports the controller's own build: its version and its commit, one GET. Name the group buildinfo.
evals.expected_output: internal/controller/endpoints/buildinfo with one GET, its input and output types, the tests of its handler, and every check passing.
assertions: dsl endpoint validate passes
the group is registered under its name
its package tests pass with 100% coverage
every test in internal/controller/endpoints/all passes
generated files are current
lint reports no issues in the group
nothing outside the group, its registration, its wiring and generated files changed

evals.prompt: Add an endpoint group to osapi for notes that operators leave on the controller: list them, add one, and delete one by its ID. The notes live in a store that the group takes as a dependency. Adding and deleting is a write. Name the group notes.
evals.expected_output: internal/controller/endpoints/notes with list, a create that answers 201, a delete that answers 204, a Deps with a store interface and its mockgen mock, refusals for a bad ID, and every check passing.
assertions: dsl endpoint validate passes
the group is registered under its name
its package tests pass with 100% coverage
every test in internal/controller/endpoints/all passes
a write needs notes:write
at least one refusal is declared with Fails
generated files are current
lint reports no issues in the group
nothing outside the group, its registration, its wiring and generated files changed
